name: Blueberry Banana Pancakes Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Blueberry Banana Pancakes is an indica dominant hybrid strain with an aroma that matches its taste. This strain features notes of bright blueberry compote and mashed banana, followed by a taste of perfectly griddled pancake, smothered in maple syrup. Its dominant terpenes include Myrcene, ß-caryophyllene, and Linalool.
